summary: Frontend testing of /app streaming web app completed. All requested features verified working: Hero section displays 'Upgrade to Premium' from admin burner, Quick access grid shows 8 tiles (4 user items + 4 admin items), Featured Albums section displays albums, Category pills visible, Album detail view opens correctly, Mini-player appears when song is selected.

issues: There's a 'Quick Access' section header visible below Featured Albums - this is from admin-configured layout sections, not the user's personal quick access grid which correctly has no header

passed_tests: Hero section displays 'Upgrade to Premium' headline from admin burner
Hero section shows subtitle 'Enjoy ad-free music with offline listening'
Quick access grid shows user items first: Liked Songs, Playlists, Downloads, My Library
Quick access grid shows admin-configured categories: Christmas Songs, Christmas
User's personal quick access grid has NO section header (correct)
Featured Albums section displays with 'Handpicked featured albums' subtitle
Album cards display with thumbnails and artist names
Category pills visible: All, Christimas Songs, Christmas
Clicking album opens album detail view with song list
Album detail shows play button, heart (favorite), and more options
Mini-player appears at bottom when song is selected
Currently playing song highlighted in green with equalizer animation
Mini-player shows song name, album art, and playback controls
critical_code_review_comments: Continuous playback implemented with repeat='all' as default
localStorage save/restore for playback state implemented (saves every 5 seconds)
Quick access grid correctly shows 8 tiles with user items first
Hero section uses burners from /api/user/home endpoint
Audio player hook handles queue management and auto-play next song
